run_modify_template_generator: run the st_templates module to generate N templated modify command samples and write them to a target directory
build_lf_dialogue_action: build a dialogue action dict with MODIFY type from a reference object and modify dictionary
generate_thicken_template: generate a thicken or thin modification template with a random target object and modify dictionary
generate_scale_template: generate a scale modification template that makes an object wider, taller, bigger, or smaller
generate_rigidmotion_template: generate a rigid motion template that moves, flips, or rotates a target object
